name: ST NUCLEO-L432KC (Nucleo-32)
description: Ultra-low-power Arduino-Nano-format Nucleo: 80 MHz Cortex-M4F with crystal-less USB FS, CAN and 256 KB flash, plus a built-in ST-LINK/V2-1.
notes: Nano pin layout (2x15, 15.24 mm row spacing) but signals differ from an Arduino Nano; IO is 3.3 V only. One user LED (LD3, shared with D13/PB3) and a reset button; no user button.
USB FS (PA11/PA12 = D10/D2) and CAN pins are on the headers only; no USB connector or CAN transceiver is fitted.
Header pin order follows ST's Nucleo-32 pinout (CN3 = D1..D12, CN4 = D13..VIN); physical orientation was derived from the Arduino Nano layout, not measured on a board.
Price is the ST eStore list price seen in late 2026 (US tariff-era pricing); older articles quote lower numbers, so re-check before ordering.
